description: This PHP source file defines a class 'TimeZone' for managing timezone operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods to validate, set, retrieve, and calculate timezone adjustments.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\TimeZone
classes.description: A class for managing timezone validation, setting, and calculation of adjustments in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone used for date/time conversions after validating it.
